title: Church Mission
definition: Church Mission is the calling of the Church to glorify God by making disciples, proclaiming Christ, and displaying the Gospel in word and deed.
summary: Church Mission is the Church's calling to glorify God by making Christ known, forming disciples, and displaying the Gospel.
christFocus: Jesus Christ sends His people as witnesses to His death, resurrection, lordship, and grace.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Church mission is the calling of the church to bear witness to Christ in the world. Scripture shows that the church exists not only to gather in worship but also to go out with the Gospel.

Mission includes evangelism, discipleship, mercy, sending, teaching, and faithful presence. It is not driven by branding or ambition, but by obedience to Jesus.

Jesus is the Lord who sends His people as witnesses. The mission belongs to Him before it belongs to any local church, ministry, or strategy.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Churches can become inward, comfortable, or program-centered. Church mission reminds believers that Christ sends His people toward the lost, the hurting, and the nations with truth and love.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask how your church is helping people hear, see, and follow Christ. Pray, give, serve, witness, disciple, and support Gospel work without turning mission into performance or self-promotion.
